section: 重启前先拍完整状态快照
items: Recursive canonical labels: Android tree, host, child, guard, seccomp, every deployment target
All /proc/mounts, /proc/1/mountinfo and every captured system/app mount target label, no 80-target cap
All param ls plus exact config_policy parameter queries
All *.cfg names and SHA in system/vendor/chipset init roots, with raw cfg contents
config_policy layer seccomp directories and libapp_filter.z.so probes
seccomp library and appspawn sandbox JSON hashes
Every appspawn/appspawn-x/foundation PID: exe, attr/current, mountinfo, environment key names only
invariants: Only read commands; no locks, reboot, relabel, service action or policy change
Every stdout/stderr/exit is preserved and SHA-bound
Missing plan, failed read, malformed labels, contradictory overlapping read or changed boot is incomplete
Live mounted data is not proof of the hidden physical underlay; reboot simulator must request that separately
